title: Pipedream alternatives, with checked prices | 50agents
description: Pipedream workflows are shutting down. Move code-heavy ones to n8n or Activepieces, simple ones to Zapier, Make or 50agents. Prices and export steps.
answer: Pipedream's workflows are shutting down and their data will be deleted, so export your projects now; the closest home for code-heavy workflows is n8n, with its Code node and self-hosting.
Activepieces is the open-source pick; for app-to-app glue with little code, Zapier and Make run JavaScript or Python steps, and 50agents rebuilds them from plain words with no code.
ask: Set up an automation: every new Stripe payment is added as a row to my Google Sheet with the customer, amount and date
lede: Pipedream users are developers, so the question is where code steps and webhooks will live next.

notice.body: Pipedream's docs: "Workflows and String are shutting down on March 31, 2027", and workflow data is deleted on April 30, 2027. Pipedream now sells Connect, its integration layer for developers.

entries.suits: The workflows a developer built for the business, not the product, such as payments into a sheet. The person who needs them describes them to Captain and approves the plan.
entries.limit: No code steps, no packages and no HTTP endpoints you write yourself. Workflows with real logic belong in one of the other tools here.

entries.suits: Developers who want code next to visual nodes. The Code node runs JavaScript or Python, one run is one execution however many steps, and you can self-host.
entries.price: No free cloud plan. Starter: €20 a month billed yearly (2.5K executions)
entries.limit: Cloud prices are in euros and billed yearly, and there is no free cloud plan.

entries.suits: Developers who want an open-source, MIT-licensed core and to own the stack, with Docker or Kubernetes installs.
entries.price: Free: 1,000 credits, up to 5 users. Plus: $20 a month flat (10,000 credits)
entries.limit: 770+ apps, far fewer than Pipedream's 3,219, so check every app your workflows call.

entries.suits: Teams who want hosted reliability and 10,541+ apps, with JavaScript or Python code steps.
entries.price: Free: 100 tasks a month. Professional: $19.99 a month billed yearly (750 tasks)
entries.limit: Every action step is a task, code steps included.

entries.suits: Developers fine with a visual canvas, who want JavaScript or Python where needed and JSON blueprints they can version.
entries.price: Free: 1,000 credits a month. Core: from $9 a month (10,000 credits)
entries.limit: Billed per credit, with most actions costing one, so many-step workflows add up.

us: The workflow is business glue, such as payments into a sheet, and the person who needs it is not a developer.
You would rather nobody maintains code for it after the move.
Sends to customers should wait for a person's yes.
them: Your workflows hold real code: n8n's Code node or Activepieces, both self-hostable.
You need 10,541+ apps and code steps in a hosted tool: Zapier.
You use Pipedream Connect inside your own product. Connect is not closing, and 50agents offers nothing like it.

move.title: Export every project now
move.body: Pipedream exports each project as a ZIP of workflow JSON files, up to 500 workflows or 256 MB per export. Credentials are removed, so list each workflow's connected accounts separately.

move.title: Copy code steps into a repository
move.body: Pull each code step into files you control. That code is what you carry into n8n's Code node or an Activepieces step.

move.title: Move webhook URLs carefully
move.body: Any app posting to a Pipedream URL needs the new URL. Change each one only when its replacement is live, and keep a list.

move.title: Finish well before the shutdown
move.body: Workflows stop on the date in the notice, and their data is deleted a month later. Leave a few weeks of side-by-side running.

faqs.a: Its workflows and String are, and workflow data is deleted a month after they stop. Pipedream Connect, its integration layer for developers, continues.

faqs.q: What is the closest alternative to Pipedream?
faqs.a: n8n, for code steps beside app nodes and the option to self-host. Activepieces is the open-source pick.

faqs.q: Can I import Pipedream workflows into another tool?
faqs.a: We found no tool that imports them. The export is Pipedream's own JSON; use it as the spec for a rebuild.
